business: Nexio CRM (cloud CRM for small Uzbek companies)
by_segment: Owner of a small shop or service business (3 to 6 staff)
Head of sales at a larger firm (15 to 50 staff)
Owner or sales head of a growing company (7 to 15 staff)
by_behaviour: Wants it set up for them
why_not: Free moving of my data is nice, but 25 dollars a month is a real chunk when I make about 500 a month, and nobody I know uses this. I would try the free 14 days at most, I would not pay yet.

My team works in a spreadsheet and it costs me nothing. A new CRM with no customer references, and I would be paying monthly out of a $13,000 year, is a hard sell when amoCRM and Bitrix24 have trials too.

My team already lives in Excel and Telegram and it works well enough. I would maybe try the free 14 days, but I would not pay in the first month because getting 10+ salespeople to change how they report is the real work, not the price.

I run everything in Excel and Telegram and it works well enough, and I have never paid for a CRM. I might look at the free trial, but paying dollars every month for something nobody I know uses is a hard sell.

I make about $5,000 a year, so 25 dollars a month is 300 a year, that is a real chunk of my income for something Excel and Telegram already do for free. My staff will not change their habit just because I pay.
why_yes: amoCRM charges me per seat and the bill keeps growing, so a flat 25 dollars for contacts and deals only is exactly what I need. Free migration and a 14-day trial with my own clients means I lose nothing by trying it.
